messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high 429 rate detected for /v1/generate across us-east region — error-rate=18% window=5m queue-depth=1248 autoscaler=unhealthy :rotating_light:
Jen (oncall): I'm paged, jumping in. paging details? any customer impact notes?
Julia (support): multiple customers reporting failures, including account acme-corp and beta-shop. They see 429s and some retries turning into timeouts.
Ryan (sre): graphs: CPU on GPU pool at 98%, k8s HPA showing replicas at cap(4) — autoscaler couldn't add more due to policy cap. Queue growth visible on ingress queue: 800 -> 1250 in 10m.
Maria (platform): Confirming, autoscaler logs show 'scale blocked by tier-policy: max_replicas=4 for tier=standard' — policy was recently tightened in rollout last week.
Kevin (prodeng): WTF. That policy change was to limit cost. We need immediate mitigation — what's the fastest path?
Jen (oncall): first mitigation: reduce rate-limiter strictness for critical customers, and switch heavy customers to the 'elevated' routing which has a higher token allowance. Can someone flip routing?
Maria (platform): I can adjust routing rules. Changing route for acme-corp to tier=priority now. Doing it via console -> routing -> set override.
ops-bot: job started: apply-routing-override acme-corp -> priority (request_id=chg-992)
Maria (platform): done for acme-corp and beta-shop. Should start flowing to priority pool which has higher caps.
Ryan (sre): seeing immediate drop in 429s for acme-corp, but global 429s still high. Priority pool has spare capacity but we're hitting token-bucket throttle on gateway for non-priority. Logs: "token_bucket: refill_rate=50r/s, burst=200" — too low for tail spikes.
Jen (oncall): can we increase gateway token refill temporarily? That should reduce 429s while we scale.
Maria (platform): Yes — updating rate-limiter config in feature flag. Patch: set refill_rate=200r/s burst=800 for us-east gateways. Pushing now.
ops-bot: deploy started: rate-limiter-config/us-east -> v2026-03-08-hotfix
Ryan (sre): Also, autoscaler still blocked. Can we raise tier policy cap to allow more replicas? Need at least +4 replicas.
Kevin (prodeng): Approve emergency-> set max_replicas=12 for standard tier for next 2 hours. Maria, can you apply?
Maria (platform): Applying change to tier policy. ops-bot: policy-update in progress.
ops-bot: policy-update complete: standard.max_replicas=12 (initiated_by=Maria)
Ryan (sre): Autoscaler started spinning up nodes. New replicas coming up. Queue depth starting to fall.
Julia (support): Customers reporting errors dropping, acme-corp back to normal, some retries succeeded.
Sam (acct): Notifying high-touch customers about mitigation and asking for confirmation they see normal traffic. Sending note to acme-corp now.
Jen (oncall): Root cause so far: 1) token-bucket/rate-limiter refill too low for sudden burst, 2) tier policy cap prevented autoscaler from adding capacity, 3) recent policy rollout made the cap stricter.
Kevin (prodeng): We need short-term and long-term actions. Short: leave policy increased and keep rate-limiter relaxed for 1hr. Long: revert policy rollout and create safe defaults + automated rollback triggers.
Maria (platform): I'll create a rollback PR for the tier policy and add a canary check to prevent blocking autoscaler when queue>500.
Ryan (sre): Also adding an autoscaler health check: if queue_backlog > 500 and avg_gpu_util > 85% then ignore tier cap for 10m (emergency scale). Will open PR.
Jen (oncall): Are there any customers with persistent errors? Julia?
Julia (support): One enterprise integration still saw timeouts due to retries hitting client-side limits. Support is coordinating a temporary client-side retry backoff recommendation.
Sam (acct): I'll loop in their account team to apply compensation if needed.
ops-bot: alert cleared: 429 rate back to baseline (3%) queue-depth=120 autoscaler=healthy
Jen (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated. We'll keep monitoring for 30m. Postmortem owner?
Kevin (prodeng): I'll own postmortem with Ryan and Maria. Action items: list in thread.
Jen (oncall): Thanks all. Quick recap for oncall handoff to next: leave routing override for priority customers for 30m, tier policy bumped to 12 temporarily (will auto-revert in 2h unless confirmed), rate-limiter patch active. Next oncall please watch queue-depth and 429 rate.
Ryan (sre): Adding action: update token-bucket defaults to refill_rate=150r/s and burst=500 as new baseline, add integration test for token-bucket under spike.
Maria (platform): Will add a config validation gate to prevent rollout that reduces max_replicas below current running replicas.
Kevin (prodeng): Postmortem timeline and customer impact summary due EOD.
Jen (oncall): Handing off to next oncall — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: handoff logged: from Jen to Alex (oncall) at 1768912720
Alex (oncall): acknowledged, watching.
